_note: THIS factory's declared exemptions for tests/test_ledger_citation_declared.py (#317). The gate reads a ledger row's OWN VOICE and reds when a `§N` has no document token (a `*.md` name) in the 70 characters BEFORE it, because a `§N` carrying NO QUALIFIER A READER CAN FOLLOW has nothing to resolve against. THE PREMISE THIS NOTE CARRIED UNTIL #547 WAS FALSE -- *"a ledger row numbers no sections of its own"* -- measured 2026-10-27 at 31 post-boundary rows carrying `## N.` / `### N.` headings (23 when #547 was filed, so the class grows with every cycle receipt that numbers its parts). The gate now DISCRIMINATES four qualifiers mechanically and reports only what none of them covers: a `*.md` document token before the number; a matching numbered heading of the CITING ROW; a row reference (`n=NNNN`) in the same clause before the number; and ANAPHORA -- the same number already qualified earlier in the row. This store exists because the ledger is APPEND-ONLY: a row written at or after the declared boundary has an EMPTY REPAIR SPACE -- the row is immutable once published, and `ledger.py repair --append-detail` inserts BEFORE the canonical trailer, i.e. AFTER the citation, so the bare number survives every lawful repair. `docs/instruments/ledger.md` section 9.6 names excusing as the remedy for exactly this shape. THE ADMISSION RULE: every entry names ONE row and carries a `reason` stating what the citation actually points at and why the row's prose is correct as written -- an exemption nobody can check is forgiveness, and this list is debt. An entry that names a row carrying NO bare citation is a STALE exemption and a gate ERROR, so the store can only ever hold rows that are actually red. Every matched entry prints as an `excused:` line on EVERY run and is counted in the population, so 'clean' and 'excused' are never the same output. A malformed or duplicated entry, or an unparseable store, is an ERROR. Absent or empty means no exemptions, never a failure. THE FIVE CLASSES OF ADMITTED ROW, each named in its reason: (1) the document is named EARLIER IN THE SAME ROW, beyond the 70-character window -- the window is a heuristic and the row is resolvable; (2) the citation is a ROW REFERENCE's own numbered part (`n=2861 §5(a)`) that the mechanical token match cannot reach, because the row reference sits in an ASIDE the own-voice scope deletes or the reference is second-order; (3) the citation is QUOTED prose reporting a bare citation that was repaired -- a quotation, not a citation; (4) the document is the meta-factory SKILL cited by its in-tree name (`SKILL §6`), whose numbering differs per tree; (5) the row is a ruling about ONE instrument and the section numbers are that instrument's own, named at the row's head. The gate cannot tell these from neglect, which is why they are declared here rather than silently passed. AFTER #547 the mechanical qualifiers above took this store from 51 entries to 38: the 13 removed were rows whose citation the predicate now qualifies for itself, so the class stopped needing a hand-written reason. The two ROW-REFERENCE entries that remain are the shapes no token match can follow.

RULING #547 -- all six citations are the defect's own SUBJECT MATTER, and this row is the second instance of the shape it rules on: the gate reds on the row that reports it. (1) and (2) '§11' twice appear inside a QUOTED harm example -- 'a brief carrying a bare §11 reached Miidas HQ asserting "your law §11 prescribes a remedy"' -- which is the #184 incident quoted verbatim, not a citation this row makes; the document is deliberately unnamed because the quote's point is that it named none. (3) 'n=4120 §4' and (4) the same in the remedy's own worked example are ROW-QUALIFIED references: §4 points at n=4120's fourth section, heading '## 4. The class my own ruling leaves unenforced', VERIFIED PRESENT in n=4120's detail. (5) and (6) '§4' appear as FIXTURE-SPEC LITERALS -- 'a row citing `§4` with a `## 4.` heading in its own body' and 'a row citing `n=M §4` where row `M` carries the heading' -- naming the literal token a test must feed the predicate, so the token is the subject of the sentence and has no document to name. A row is not a document, so no `*.md` token exists to place in the 70-character window for any of the six. WHY THIS IS THE EVIDENCE FOR #547 RATHER THAN A WORKAROUND: the ruling at this very row withdraws the gate's premise ('a ledger row numbers no sections of its own') as false at 26 rows and 9 of 49 entries, and scopes the remedy to two token matches the gate already has machinery for. Until that lands, the gate cannot express 'a citation qualified by a row reference, a quoted harm, or a fixture literal', so it must be told. Same shape as this store's n=4050, n=4068, n=4121 and n=4124 entries; the prose is correct as written and needs no repair.

WHY THIS ENTRY IS THE THIRD INSTANCE OF THE SHAPE #547 RULES ON: a gate that reds on a bare citation reds hardest on the row whose subject IS the bare citation, because reporting the defect requires quoting the token. The row cannot be repaired in place -- #317 makes the repair space empty, since `ledger.py repair --append-detail` inserts BEFORE the canonical trailer and therefore AFTER the citation -- so excusing it is the remedy docs/instruments/ledger.md §9.6 names. Same shape as this store's n=4068, n=4124 and n=4133 entries; the prose is correct as written and needs no repair.
